01_早產31w_直接入院_RDS_surfactant.plan:
Diagnostic plans:
- Obtain a sepsis work-up, including CBC/DC, CRP, B/C, CXR, and urine GBS Ag
- Check Dex STAT and Q6H (indications: prematurity)

Therapeutic plans:
- Provide incubator (Giraffe) care, with a radiant warmer PRN
- Minimize handling in critically ill infants
- Monitor EKG and SpO2
- Record the body weight daily
- Start caffeine citrate for apnea of prematurity (loading dose 20 mg/kg, then 5–10 mg/kg/day); continue until at least a PMA of 34 weeks and 5–7 days without apnea

- Provide OG decompression
- Advance nutritional support with parenteral nutrition (PN)
- Initiate early enteral trophic feeding with breast milk once the infant's general condition and breathing pattern stabilize; encourage exclusive breast milk feeding
- For enteral feeding, use an OG tube and prioritize the mother's own breast milk, followed by donor human milk from the human milk bank, and then preterm infant formula or preterm special care formula

Prognostic plans:
- Monitor for complications of prematurity: RDS, CLD, ROP, oxidative stress, NEC, PDA, IVH, etc.
- Arrange the first ROP screening examination (at 4 weeks of age or a PMA of 31 weeks, whichever is later)
- Obtain cranial ultrasonography at 7–10 days of age and again at a PMA of 36 weeks
